result.claim_boundary: Internal project-operated evidence from exactly two precommitted ARC tasks in one transpose family. It supports only the exact bounded sequential-transfer unit and does not establish generalized ARC capability, cross-family transfer, production reliability, autonomous self-improvement, AGI, Candidate activation, upper-objective completion, or user-level completion.
result.next: Return to Root and select a materially different immutable cross-family ARC transfer unit. Retain pre-reveal ordering, task-A-only learning, deterministic scoring, source/task/holder/leakage/replay controls, zero-upstream-write auditing, protected exact-head CI, expected-head merge, remote readback, and separate bounded versus upper-objective verdicts.
result.reason: The episode supplies one well-controlled but single-family transfer result. Existing immutable-source, pre-reveal, replay, Candidate-gating, and separated-verdict mechanisms already preserve the reusable lesson. Proposing or activating a new prompt or mechanism Candidate from two transpose tasks would overgeneralize beyond the evidence; the next need is a materially different falsifiable unit, not a control-plane change.
retained_learning: Bind external benchmark work to an immutable upstream commit, exact task identities, deterministic selection, content digests, and a zero-upstream-write audit.
Freeze the baseline before learning, permit the learning record to contain only task-A evidence, and freeze the task-B prediction before task-B output reveal.

A holder commitment plus explicit answer-bearing-field exclusion makes the no-leakage boundary auditable; retain changed-source, changed-task, changed-selector, mismatched-holder, leakage, and duplicate-replay controls.
Report baseline task-A, baseline task-B, and adapted task-B scores separately so improvement and exactness can be independently recomputed.

A successful same-family two-task transfer is evidence only for that declared unit; it is not evidence of cross-family generalization, open-ended rule induction, autonomous continual learning, production reliability, AGI, or user-level completion.
Keep bounded-unit, task, user-level, upper-objective, Candidate-activation, and AGI verdicts separate through Execute, Task Evaluate, Consolidate, Learn, and Root.
Exact-head CI, expected-head merge, and remote blob readback establish repository durability but cannot widen the empirical capability claim.
